title: ClientSide+
description: This project features all the best clientside mods, in order to make minecraft more visually stunning and refreshing to play. while keeping the core mechanics and keeping the game unchanged.
body:
This is the offical modpack "ClientSide+", which offeres players a visually stunning and beautiful appearence to the popular game that players are familliar with :)

This modpack features mods such as:
- FlashBack
- Fresh Animations
- 3D Skin Layers & 3D Armor
- JEI (Just Enough Items)
- Mouse Tweaks
- Punchy!
- Simple Voice Chat
- Sounds

and many, many more :)

And if you dont enjoy the modpack, you can always uninstall :)
